project_context.app_type: Dashboard / SaaS App (Gestão Operacional de Marmitaria e Restaurantes)
project_context.target_audience: Restaurantes, marmitarias, operações de alimentação, atendentes e administradores de pedidos
project_context.core_vibe: Organic, warm, efficient, organized, reliable, tactile food management

theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A food operations dashboard should feel warm, inviting, and operational without feeling like a sterile cold portal. Warm terracotta/burnt orange accents paired with stone warm grays evoke a cozy kitchen environment.

rules.anti_default: Never use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk for headings.

rules.tints: Never use pure grey #000000 or neutral #808080. Tint neutrals with warm stone or warm amber tones.
rules.contrast: Text below 18px must have at least 4.5:1 ratio against background. Always set explicit hover text colors.

spacing_and_layout.system: Tailwind standard scale (p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12).

dashboard_grid.type: Control Room Grid & Responsive Kanban/List view
dashboard_grid.rules: Dense, scan-first operational layout. Top metrics showing live revenue, active orders, pending dispatch, and item counts. Use gap-4 or gap-6 for control widgets.
dashboard_grid.cards: Subtle roundness (rounded-xl max). 1px border-stone-200. Ambient shadow (shadow-sm). Use flat lists where density is high.

specific_customizations.buttons: rounded-lg, font-medium. Primary buttons use #C5533B with clear hover states.
specific_customizations.badges: Order Status Badges: Novo (Info), Em Preparo (Warning), Pronto (Success), Em Entrega (Brand/Accent), Concluído (Neutral Dark), Cancelado (Danger).
specific_customizations.tables: Border-collapse with border-b border-stone-200. Left-align text, right-align numbers and prices.

motion.rules: Functional micro-interactions. Fast transitions for hover states (duration-200 ease-in-out). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
motion.hover_states: Interactive buttons, nav items, and table rows must change background color smoothly.

login_background.usage: Full-bleed background for authentication split screen with warm overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React.js (.js/.jsx files only, NO TypeScript), Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_requirements: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='order-status-badge').
instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: Build a responsive layout with fixed/collapsible left Sidebar for desktop and drawer/bottom nav for mobile. Active order queue with Kanban or tabbed List view.
instructions_to_main_agent.language: All UI text, labels, statuses, error messages, and dummy data MUST be in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_usage: Do NOT use raw HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Always use shadcn/ui DropdownMenu, Select, Calendar, Dialog, Tabs, etc.
instructions_to_main_agent.mock_data: Use the provided image URLs for product photos. Do not use generic placeholders like via.placeholder.com.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: Every button, input, tab, badge, table row action, modal trigger, and link MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rule: Ensure 4.5:1 text contrast ratio on all buttons and labels.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsive_rule: Desktop and mobile navigation must be fully responsive and seamless.
